title: Staggered GPU procurement pipeline & regional allocation (Q3–Q4 plan)
content:
Purpose:
A tranche-based procurement plan for GPU capacity to cover Q3–Q4 projected demand across regions. Focus: staggered orders to smooth supplier lead-time volatility, reduce customs/ramp bottlenecks, and preserve a 6% operational buffer for burst workloads. Use this as the operational schedule for procurement ops and infra finance reviews.

Executive summary:
- Current usable fleet (global): 3,920 GPUs (mixed: A100/80GB, H100, L4)
- Target fleet by 2026-12-31: 6,500 GPUs (~66% growth) to support forecasted steady-state 95 p95 latency pods and 4x peak batch windows.
- Strategy: Split orders into 3 tranches (A/B/C) across vendors and regions. Prioritize H100 for latency-critical hosted API shards and A100 for dedicated pools. Use L4 for embedding-heavy/cheap workloads.

Inventory snapshot (as-of 2026-02-20):
Region | Installed GPUs | In-transit | Available | Average util (30d) | Primary SKU mix
US-W | 1,740 | 120 | 1,660 | 78% | 40% H100 / 45% A100 / 15% L4
EU-C | 1,080 | 80 | 1,000 | 82% | 30% H100 / 55% A100 / 15% L4
AP-S | 600 | 20 | 580 | 74% | 20% H100 / 40% A100 / 40% L4 (planned increase)
Other | 500 | 40 | 460 | 64% | mixed rented/spot
Global total | 3,920 | 260 | 3,660 | 76% avg | 32% H100 / 50% A100 / 18% L4

Identified deficit vs target (6,500 target): global short = 2,580 GPUs. Plan to source 2,700 to include 120 safety buffer.

Proposed procurement tranches (high level):
Tranche A (Jan–Mar 2026) — near-term, short lead: 900 units
- Goal: patch immediate hotspots in US-W and EU-C for chat/hosted low-latency shards.
- SKU mix: 400 H100, 400 A100, 100 L4 (vendor: Hypersupplier A + reseller mix)
- Typical lead times: H100 8–12 weeks, A100 6–10 weeks, L4 2–6 weeks
- Notes: Partial shipments (two-week cadence) to reduce customs queue.

Tranche B (Apr–Aug 2026) — staggered bulk: 1,200 units
- Goal: bulk capacity for Dedicated and Private commitments.
- SKU mix: 600 A100, 400 H100, 200 L4 (vendor: Hypersupplier B + direct OEM for A100)
- Lead times (current estimates): OEM A100 12–20 weeks, H100 10–16 weeks; expect delays if silicon allocation changes.
- Financing: capex release request (INF-429) in pipeline.

Tranche C (Sep–Dec 2026) — tail and buffer: 600 units + 120 contingency
- Goal: finish regional parity, support AP expansion, replace EOL returns.
- SKU mix: 250 H100, 250 A100, 220 L4/alternative low-power cards
- Consider leasing 200 GPUs in AP-S to handle initial ramp while customs/power contracts finalize.

Staggering rationale and benefits:
- Reduced single-point supplier risk: split across two primary vendors and one reseller pool.
- Smoother customs/import handling: smaller shipments cleared faster and less likely to be flagged for special inspection.
- Electrical/cooling ramping: facilities can bring racks online iteratively, avoiding large one-time buildouts.
- Price timing: stagger helps average out short-term price spikes and Fx volatility.

Regional allocation guideline (post-delivery distribution):
- US: 48% of H100 capacity (hosted API heavy)
- EU: 30% of H100 (compliance + latency)
- APAC: 22% of H100 (initially through lease + backlog deliveries)
- A100 distribution follows demand signals from Dedicated contracts (per-contract pinning allowed).

Operational constraints & risks:
- Supplier EOL changes: if H1 2026 silicon allocation tightens, move 15% of H100 order to A100 or postpone + lease.
- Customs delays (EU import surge): prepare 3 alternative forwarders; target <10 day port dwell.
- Freight windows (LCL vs FCL): prefer FCL for tranches >200 units to reduce per-unit shipping lag.
- Power/capacity: SRE must confirm PDUs and breaker capacity 6 weeks prior to tranche arrival.
- Refurb market pull: salvage pool as fallback for non-critical batch workloads (expect 10% performance delta).

Cost and budget snapshot (estimates, USD):
- Tranche A estimated spend: $28.5M (avg unit cost weighted: H100 $22k, A100 $16k, L4 $6k)
- Tranche B estimated spend: $38.4M
- Tranche C estimated spend: $18.6M + leasing contingency $1.2M
- Note: taxes, freight, and import duties ~8% region-avg; include 5–8% FX buffer for APAC contracts.

Short table: procurement schedule (months vs shipments)
Month | Expected shipments | Primary SKUs | Notes
2026-01 | Partial A shipments (200) | A100/H100 | US-W priority
2026-02 | Partial A shipments (300) | A100/H100/L4 | customs staging in EU
2026-03 | Final A shipments (400) | H100/A100 | finish tranche A
2026-04–06 | B phased shipments (600) | A100/H100 | OEM batch 1
2026-07–08 | B bulk shipments (600) | A100/H100/L4 | finish tranche B
2026-09–12 | C shipments & leases (720 incl buffer) | mixed | AP ramp + contingent

Mitigation playbook (if lead times slip):
- Short-term: increase spot/leased pool in region (target 300 leased by handoff)
- Mid-term: shift SKU ratio (defer 15% H100 -> A100) and enable quantization profiles to reduce footprint by 10–15% for non-LLM-hosted workloads
- Long-term: accelerate partnerships with alternative fabs/resellers and explore resale buyback clauses in vendor contracts

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Final approval on tranche B capex and contract signatory (who signs OEM clause for delivery windows?). Action: @Priya to confirm legal approver by 2026-02-28.
- Lease vs buy threshold for APAC: recommend leasing if customs + power not confirmed 45 days before scheduled AP delivery.
- Should we prioritize A100 for Dedicated over Hosted? Proposed policy: prioritize Dedicated contractual obligations; surplus to Hosted.

Action items (owner -> brief):
- Priya Kapoor -> finalize vendor quotes and reserve initial LOI windows (due 2026-02-28).
- Marco Nguyen -> validate rack/power readiness for US-W/EU-C for tranche A (due 2026-02-10).
- Asha Patel -> run cost-sensitivity model for 10% FX swings and share results (due 2026-02-25).
- Ethan Li -> submit tranche A PO and coordinate logistics (ongoing).

Appendix: quick checklist before each incoming shipment
- PO confirmed & ASN received
- Customs docs (commercial invoice, packing list) cleared with forwarder
- On-site PDU & floor load confirmed with SRE
- Spare parts + GPU return box kits staged
- Tagging and serial capture plan for inventory DB (ops-inventory PR/87)

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally a working sheet; numbers are estimates and vendor lead times are changing weekly. Please annotate inline or add comments in the procurement tracker spreadsheet linked above.

Unresolved threads / timeline sensitivity:
- Waiting on OEM confirmation for A100 batch 2 window (expected by 2026-02-22).
- Freight rate lock negotiation opens 2026-02-28 (need signoff).

Bottom line: staggered tranches + mixed-supplier approach minimizes single-event risk and helps operations scale power/cooling. Approve tranche A to avoid near-term shortages; finalize tranche B capex decision by end of Q1.
